answer: A prism splits each identity's claim into three beams at the oasis, and the sable ledger records the spectrum of each. Two claims bending the same spectrum belong to one operator: both are voided at settlement, their 400,000 POA bonds burn, their rewards pass to honest peers, and the operator pays a 258,000 POA fine per fake. Five fakes therefore cost 3,290,000 POA before any payout clears.
